Hi, I'm **Josh Chettiar**. I write small, honest experiments on new ML and AI releases:
what they do, how they compare to a well-known baseline, and where they fall short.

Every post comes with a notebook with pinned versions and an *Open in Colab* button, so you can rerun it yourself.
